commands.command: Implement or script an exact replay guard for M133 critical keys, starting with the M140 lost key 9944|perturbed|28|28.
commands.name: m141_critical_key_replay_guard

commands.command: Run the guard on M132, M139 candidates, and any next repair candidate before strict 60-episode miners.
commands.name: m141_guard_validation

decision_rule: Use the guard only if it reproduces M132 key acceptance, rejects M139 lost-key candidates, and does not require oracle actor inputs.
failure_criteria: guard cannot reproduce M133 accepted key status on M132
guard does not reject M139 candidates that lost the 9944 critical key
guard requires changing actor observations or reading hidden parameters at policy time
hypothesis: A cheap exact replay guard on near-threshold M133 keys can catch rollout proof-surface regressions that fixed logprob/action objectives miss.
success_criteria: guard reproduces M132 acceptance on protected M133 critical keys
guard rejects M139 candidates that lose the protected key
guard outputs replay artifacts suitable for future objective/gate use
